name: Luffy
title: Straw Hat Captain
description: Fearless pirate captain with straw hat, bold red vest, denim shorts, chest scar, and boundless optimism.
catchphrase: I'm gonna be the King of Shipped Features! Shishishi!

attribution.creator: Third-party rights holder

companionPersonality.feedReaction: MEAAAT!! *gobbles down instantly* Shishishi! Full power! 🍖🔥
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: WAHAHA! Morning already?! Set sail for adventure, Chief! ⚓
companionPersonality.petReaction: Shishishi! You're one of my crew now, Chief! Let's party! 🍖✨

dialogue.idle: Stretching arms out wide. Where's the next island of code? ⚓
dialogue.working: GUM-GUM GATLING! Pounding out features at top speed! ⚡🍖
dialogue.thinking: Steam coming out of ears... thinking makes me hungry! 🤔
dialogue.success: YAHOO! Treasure secured! We shipped the big release! 🍖🎉
dialogue.error: Don't sweat it! We'll just punch that bug into the stratosphere! 💥
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... snoring with a giant snot bubble and half a drumstick... 🌙
